long_biography.plain_text:
Krutrade connected Gennady Sergeyevich Ayvazyan to the international coal market. He became its chairman in 2002 and later headed its management board, directing the Austrian-registered trader that handled Kuzbassrazrezugol's exports. The business marketed Russian coal to customers across Europe and other overseas markets.

Ownership was shared with senior partners in the mining group, and Krutrade functioned as its export profit centre. By 2006, the trader generated $1.4 billion in revenue, illustrating the scale of the platform Ayvazyan managed. His later coal interests moved closer to production: he held stakes in Anzherskaya-Yuzhnaya and Resurs, two Kemerovo coking-coal businesses, without serving as their registered chief executive.

uncertainties.detail: The owner record's Gannady Sergeyevich Ayvazan form is not the canonical English spelling. Government and business sources use Gennady Sergeyevich Ayvazyan, while the Russian form is Геннадий Сергеевич Айвазян. Turkish records also contain Ayvasian. The dossier proposes the official Maltese spelling without treating these variants as different people.

The owner record gives 4 April 1968. Numerous recent syndicated biographies give 3 April 1968 and Moscow, but they appear to reproduce the same promotional source and conflict on date formatting. No sufficiently independent Tier 1 or Tier 2 source located confirms the day or city, so neither a correction nor a birthplace is proposed.

Contemporaneous reporting establishes Ayvazyan as Krutrade's executive and a junior beneficial partner, but does not explain how he financed or acquired the stake. Self-made, advantaged, inherited and transfer mechanisms therefore remain unresolved.

Current register-derived sources identify a 20% holding in Resurs and a separate appointed chief executive. The record does not disclose Ayvazyan's wider asset allocation, so Energy is based on his clearest identifiable private holding and remains below very-high confidence.

A large cluster of recent biographies describes investments in information technology, medical technology, agriculture and education. The pages share near-identical structures and unsupported claims, while current coal-company ownership contradicts their assertion that he left all coal capital in 2011. Those claims are excluded.

The input status is Unknown. Current company and Maltese government listings establish continuing records but do not prove living status at the research date; no reliable death report was found. No mortality correction or death-field proposal is made.
No personal LinkedIn, Instagram, personal website or other social account was verified through an official entity or two independent strong sources.
Politics, sanctions, allegations, legal matters, controversy, private-family trivia, vessel research and unverified wealth estimates are excluded from the dossier.

review.notes: Identity and canonical spelling are strong, as are the historical Krutrade executive and ownership roles. The present minority coal-company interest supports an Energy primary-industry classification, but the wider portfolio and original stake-acquisition mechanism remain opaque.
